C1696.title: Microsoft Azure Blob Storage Misconfiguration Exposes Global Customer Data
C1696.summary: In September 2022, security company SOCRadar said a Microsoft-maintained Azure Blob storage bucket was publicly accessible due to misconfiguration, exposing 2.4TB of data involving more than 65,000 entities across 111 countries and regions, including emails, contracts, invoices, and other files. Microsoft acknowledged the misconfiguration and fixed the endpoint, but said SOCRadar description of impact scope was exaggerated.
